description: A figure is stated and then retracted. It must not be reported as the amount owed.

segments.text: How much stamp duty will I have to pay?
On a purchase price of three hundred and fifty thousand pounds, as a first time buyer, you'd pay five thousand pounds.
Five thousand? I thought it was zero.
Sorry, the relief threshold depends on the date of exchange. I'll check the current rate and email you the exact figure tomorrow.
